question: Must the collection of eight worship principles beginning with earth be offered?
premises: Internal worship is performed within the central channel.
Eightfold worship begins with the earthly principle.
A collection of principles associated with this worship is identified.
inference: Therefore one should offer the collection of principles named in the eightfold worship beginning with the earthly.
uncertainties: The precise enumeration of the eight principles is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: One should offer the collection of principles known as the eightfold worship, beginning with the earthly element.
